snippet.title: Legends of Castile - Kickstarter launch trailer
snippet.description:
Legends of Castile arrives to Kickstarter on October 29th!!🟢

Follow our Kickstarter page before the campaign starts to ensure you don't miss out on the juicy rewards and early bird discounts! If the campaign has already launched, check out the rewards at the same link and make a pledge if you find something you like!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/torrezno/legends-of-castile-a-folk-point-and-click-adventure-game

Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain in the 19th century. It follows a village girl who must investigate the region's folk legends to fulfill her dream of becoming a nun.

Sign up for our newsletter to receive information and insights about the campaign and the project. Plus, you'll get an additional item in the main character’s inventory when you buy the game!

https://tiny.cc/legends-news

More information at:
https://www.legendsofcastile.com

Wishlist the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325200/Legends_of_Castile/
